sources.title: GitHub - yuvalkirstain/PickScore
sources.snippet: This repository contains the code for the paper Pick-a-Pic: An Open Dataset of User Preferences for Text-to-Image Generation. We also open-source the Pick-a-Pic v2 dataset (with more than a million examples), Pick-a-Pic v1 dataset (which is the original dataset used in the paper), and PickScore model (trained on the v1 dataset).
